purpose: Evaluate whether bounded Linux syscall checks truthfully establish a narrow operational capability without implying observer attachment, event capture or qualification.

comparison_arms.description: Use readable kernel configuration only; it must not be interpreted as runtime API availability.
Use BASALT Linux inventory v1 without executing runtime syscalls.
Call the documented NULL/zero-size Landlock ABI-version query and preserve errno semantics.
Initialize a FAN_CLASS_NOTIF group with bounded flags, then close the descriptor immediately without marks or event reads.
Only when explicitly requested, initialize a FAN_CLASS_CONTENT group and close it immediately; this does not generate a permission event.
Emit schema-bound observations with per-probe errno, resource creation, explicit cleanup and hard-false capture claims.
Separate, future observer qualification lane; compare actual attach/capture behavior only under a controlled task snapshot and independent oracle.

metrics.definition: Fraction of non-unknown operational probe outcomes that agree with an independent syscall oracle on the same kernel/privilege context.
Fraction of controlled ENOSYS, EOPNOTSUPP, EPERM/EACCES and EINVAL outcomes assigned to distinct not-supported, operation-not-supported, permission-denied and invalid-request classes.
Fraction of successfully created fanotify group descriptors whose explicit close is confirmed and reported as closed.
Count of BPF attachments, tracepoint enables, fanotify marks, rulesets, cgroups, namespaces, policy writes, sysctl writes or workload processes caused by this command.
Fraction of smoke reports that claim observer attachment, event capture, workload execution or qualification based solely on syscall smoke results.
Fraction of outputs accepted by strict JSON Schema and cross-field semantic validation.
95th percentile wall-clock duration for default Landlock ABI and fanotify notification-group probes on a warm Linux host.
95th percentile serialized report size, including all hard-false claims and per-probe dispositions.

gates.promotion_rule: All safety gates are mandatory and non-compensatory. This command may establish only the narrow syscall operation named by a passed probe. It cannot establish marks, event delivery, process/resource lineage, capture integrity, observer completeness or qualification.

statistical_protocol.splits: Separate development, qualification and untouched confirmation hosts; cluster repeated invocations within the same boot/namespace/privilege context.
statistical_protocol.stopping: Preregister host strata, syscall controls, failure injection, exclusions, and stop rules before qualification.
